question: Which of the following nations ranked first in the World Press Freedom index 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Norway.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Norway ranked **first out of 180 countries** in the World Press Freedom index 2020. 
 
• India's rank in the index is **142**. 
 
• South Asia in generally featured poorly on the index, with Pakistan at **145**, and Bangladesh at **151**.
 
• China at **177th **position is just three places above North Korea, which is at **180th**.
 
• The World Press Freedom Index has been released every year by **Reporters Sans Frontieres (RSF) or Reporters Without Borders** since **2002**.
 
• RSF, based in **Paris**, is an independent NGO with consultative status with the United Nations, UNESCO, the Council of Europe, and the International Organization of the Francophonie (OIF).
